item.title: Avian Influenza Hits Poultry Industry
item.description: WALKER COUNTY, GA. (WDEF) – The Georgia Department of Agriculture has confirmed a case of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) at a commercial poultry operation, marking the first confirmed case in Georgia in 2026.
